mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 42 degrees at the Military Ridge State Trail. With the First Quarter moon out, look up to see the ISS passing overhead tonight starting at 5:42 AM; it will rise in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and track toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, reaching high in the sky.
The City of Verona has updated its zoning and sign ordinances, and officials remind residents that four polling locations are open for elections from 7 AM to 8 PM.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by a variety of trivia nights and live music events occurring tomorrow and throughout the week.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving; no injuries were reported to the students on board.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with today's featured flavor of the day, Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
